body:
Issue #1 starts from a pipeline template with arithmetic examples. This change adds a public-domain JavaScript quality engine and inline Git evolution analysis through a CLI, the typed `/quality` library entry point, and a bounded HTTP API with a non-root Docker image.

**Implementation remains in progress. Exhaustive competitor/documented-case parity and full quality-bash parity are unfinished acceptance criteria. The strict readiness command rejects them; current functionality and passing tests do not establish universal superiority. Keep this PR unmerged.**

- Parse and extract abstractions for every language named in the pinned Hive Mind guidance, plus Bash and TSX. Apply original structural, duplication, whitespace and heuristic security rules. Measure literal CMake formal arity and structural decisions with an original adapter. Refuse unresolved headers and unsupported custom tree rules; record remaining evaluation limitations.
- Add deterministic JSON/text/SARIF, versioned plugins, declarative AST rules, explicit trusted analyzer adapters, and monotonic finding/coverage/mutation baselines. Locked atomic writes and `--baseline-ref` enforce working and committed target-revision floors. Fresh report bundles preserve failed/incomplete evidence and raw coverage outputs.
- Track files/functions/classes and other grammar abstractions through bounded, read-only Git history. Preserve identities with unique evidence, rank repeated edits, and attach source evidence to observational suggestions.
- Add shell syntax/ShellCheck/Bats/kcov/mutation orchestration, independent stages, repeatable file selection, bounded workers, audited baseline migrations and source-preserving upstream-schema import through fresh independent QA. Reject missing Bash prerequisites, tool changes during measurement, duplicate JSON fields and malformed Bats TAP.
- Download checksum-pinned Bats 1.14, ShellCheck 0.11 and Debian kcov 43 for Linux x64/arm64 into exclusively owned output. Download a separately pinned private Debian library closure without sudo or maintainer scripts; retain notices, check loader resolution and fingerprint the entire managed tree before and after measurement. Host Bash >=5.2, glibc >=2.36, Python and system configuration remain explicit dependencies/limits.
- Add a consumer GitHub Action with literal arguments, automatic PR-base baseline enforcement, fresh installation-failure evidence and owned temporary cleanup.
- Provide command-specific usage/options without project configuration or external tools. Correct Windows drive-prefix and macOS canonical-root validation while preserving all refusal assertions.
- Add original arithmetic mutations and exact count arithmetic with default floor or explicit fingerprinted half-up rounding. Require reviewed migration for earlier shell methods. Record actual released-CLI QA, cache-freshness refusals and floor-preserving baseline import on two original fixtures with identical external tools.
- Verify every bounded workspace input, including helper data, unselected helpers and permissions, across shell stages. Refuse additions/deletions/changes, share copy exclusions and record tree evidence with a versioned method. A real passing Bats control reproduces the helper change and corrected refusal.
- Add optional token-block clones with explicit identifier/literal normalization, minimum lengths, maximal nonoverlapping pairs, exact ranges and SARIF related locations in all thirteen language modes. Native CMake command/parenthesis/argument tokens preserve raw kinds, dynamic references and generator markers. Include normalized-token signatures in baseline identities; refuse incomplete metrics and exhausted work budgets. Version the CMake token policy and require reviewed baseline migration. A finite independent oracle checks 300 token-index cases.
- Add opt-in `CPD-OFF`/`CPD-ON` comment regions across all thirteen modes, strict malformed-marker refusals, segment boundaries and audited UTF-16 ranges. Syntax validation and structural rules remain active; suppressed tokens still consume work budgets. Explicit false retains default behavior and methods.
- Collect verified token-pair locations into deterministic `cloneGroups` in JSON, text and SARIF without changing pair findings, gates, signatures or method fingerprints. Deduplicate locations by language, token count and normalized signature; preserve overlapping groups and separate signatures.
- Add opt-in Java/C# annotation and C# using-directive clone filters while preserving syntax checks, other rules, comment markers and shared token budgets. Keep annotation declarations, using statements/declarations and other languages visible. Correct six Java numeric literal families; version enabled filters/normalization and require reviewed baseline migrations.
- Add optional native structural tree rules with exact grammar node/text/field/operator constraints, ordered named children, captures, repeated structural equality and one anchored sequence wildcard. Ignore comments/formatting for capture equality while preserving operators, literal spelling and tree shape. Validate pattern size and share finite candidate/capture work; applicable CMake rules still refuse incomplete analysis.
- Compose native rules with candidate-local `all`/`any`/`not` filters. Each clause inherits an isolated copy of parent captures and discards temporary bindings; Boolean truth values do not depend on sibling order. Bound clause visits and copied entries. Preserve legacy/no-filter methods and findings, version enabled rules/filters, and require reviewed baseline migrations. This is an independently designed object API; Semgrep syntax/range/binding semantics and complete rule parity remain missing.
- Correct valid Bash literal/pattern/case/heredoc parsing using the pinned official Bash 0.23.3 WASM release and compatible isolated runtime. Verify artifact integrity before parsing, retain its MIT license, handle both runtime node APIs and anonymous comparison fields, preserve non-Bash method identities, and require reviewed Bash baseline migration. Record a finite released/native operator audit without claiming full parity.
- Restrict shell mutations to actual operator fields and command-list operators, preserving quoted logical text and comparison operands. Add opt-in expanded arithmetic ordering and a second multiplication fault model through the library, CLI and Action; fingerprint policies and refuse partial inventories. Correct npm alias normalization in the strict Deno dependency guard while retaining all inventory and resolution assertions.
- Add opt-in native JS/TS/TSX straight-line taint models with exact sources/sanitizer returns, conservative simple parameter sources, assignments, eager expressions and selected sink arguments. Preserve ordered source-to-sink paths in JSON/text/SARIF and baseline identities. Reject shadowed/escaped bindings, unsupported control flow and exhausted budgets as incomplete; preserve default behavior and methods. Local calls, closures, heap, framework and full compiler/interfile semantics remain unfinished.
- Preserve the existing browser-compatible arithmetic entry point, example CLI and pipeline features. Add one minor Changeset, preserve earlier release notes/bump types, and retain third-party notices.
- Collect source snapshots, clean-room provenance, competitor comparisons, requirement mapping, alternatives and explicit gaps under [the case study](https://github.com/link-foundation/code-quality/tree/issue-1-f401f7eb3981/docs/case-studies/issue-1).

The requested later extraction is tracked at https://github.com/link-foundation/code-evolution/issues/1; the implementation remains inline here. Competitor implementation and test-suite files were not opened or copied. Public report-format documentation contains illustrative source excerpts; none were copied or used as fixtures. The research ledger records this distinction.

Reproduce the new behavior:

```sh
npm ci
node bin/code-quality.js check ./src --format json
node bin/code-quality.js evolution . --max-commits 10
node bin/code-quality.js serve .
node bin/code-quality.js check examples/code-quality/taint --config examples/code-quality/taint/quality.json --format sarif
```

The taint example exits 1 with one unsanitized flow; the sanitized file stays clean. Its inputs are analyzed without execution. The original escaped-binding regression fails before the draft correction and passes afterward; unsupported cases refuse complete baselines.

Validation at `58e3221e54d7fdf53be2252398e83f0ffed39dff`:

- All 319 selected Node checks and 312 Bun/frozen-Deno cases pass without skips, including existing dependency and JavaScript-first guards. Twenty new flow/consumer tests cover exact calls, overwrite/copy behavior, nested sinks, selected arguments, multiple origins, Unicode locations, type assertions, independent scopes, early returns, malformed models, bounded work and CLI/HTTP/text/SARIF. Existing acceptance assertions remain intact.
- `npm run check` passes without lint/format warnings (6.30% duplicated lines). Types, Changeset validation, all 449 tracked-file line guards, installed-tarball smoke and isolated release versioning pass. Release fragments produce `0.11.31` to `1.0.0`, preserving the prior major fragment. All twenty research snapshot hashes match. Seven source-hashed flow observations reproduce within a 128 MiB Node heap and bounded stack.
- All six preceding `8dc4a7d` workflows pass on attempt one, including all nine runtime legs, both native shell architectures, distribution/container and desktop packaging. [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-foundation/code-quality/actions/runs/44205208691) confirms the dependency-guard correction. New same-revision CI is pending; full real-shell and container checks remain covered there.
- The preceding actual shell observations retain 75% coverage and the original 100%/66.66% mutation fixtures, 3/5 arithmetic coverage and 2/3 detection, default 66.66 or explicit half-up 66.67, baseline import, migration, consumer Action, failed evidence and helper-change refusal. The expanded example records standard 0/1 versus expanded 5/6 mutants killed (83.33%); different denominators do not establish an accuracy ranking.
- Every incremental change was reviewed, including the whole final candidate diff, which matches the reviewed draft byte-for-byte. GitHub's combined PR diff exceeds its 20,000-line service limit; paginated PR file blobs are checked against reviewed local Git. All 217 preceding file blob identities match. The shipped Bash grammar is pinned to the observed official HTTPS release binary; no independent build reproducibility claim is made.
- Reviewed dependency pins, bounded security regressions, frozen graphs and audit thresholds remain intact. `npm run quality:readiness` deliberately returns seven explicit refusals for unfinished compiler/project semantics, partial CMake/taint adapters, exhaustive competitor/proprietary cases and full quality-bash parity. No production Rust jobs are introduced.

Fixes #1
title: feat: add native quality analysis and inline code evolution
